author: KevineCove
body: Swansong used to be terrible but with the new update it's extremely powerful, specifically for horde content with Beowulf Hydrus. Swansong's special ability uses both attack and magic which makes it good for hybrid classes like Beowulf and Deity, but it also has the ability to crit. When Beowulf Hydrus crits you recover a huge chunk of HP and MP, and this can stack when hitting multiple enemies. So theoretically you could wipe out 5-6 enemies at once and get a full heal all from the same action.
